question: How many superheroes have blue eyes?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'

question: List the superhero names of all heroes published by Dark Horse Comics.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

question: Which publisher has the largest number of superheroes?
evidence: Ignore heroes whose publisher name is empty.
sql: SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name <> '' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average height of female superheroes with a recorded height?
evidence: female refers to gender = 'Female'; recorded height refers to height_cm > 0
sql: SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND s.height_cm > 0

question: How many superheroes can fly?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Flight'

question: What is the name of the heaviest superhero?
sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = (SELECT MAX(weight_kg) FROM superhero)

question: How many superheroes have an Intelligence value of 100?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND ha.attribute_value = 100

question: How many villains are published by Marvel Comics?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question: What percentage of DC Comics superheroes are female?
evidence: percentage = COUNT(gender = 'Female') * 100 / COUNT(*) for publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

question: List all the powers of Wolverine.
sql: SELECT sp.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Wolverine'

question: Which race has the most superheroes?
evidence: Do not count the placeholder race '-'.
sql: SELECT r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race <> '-' GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many superheroes have the same eye and hair colour?
evidence: Exclude heroes whose colour is 'No Colour'.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id AND c.colour <> 'No Colour'

question: How many superheroes have more than 30 powers?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power GROUP BY hero_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 30)

question: Which superhero has the most powers?
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average weight of superheroes with green skin?
evidence: green skin refers to skin colour = 'Green'
sql: SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour = 'Green'

question: List the names of neutral superheroes published by Marvel Comics.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question: How many powers does Superman have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Superman'

question: What colour are Batman's eyes?
sql: SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Batman'

question: Which attribute has the highest average value across all heroes?
sql: SELECT a.attribute_name FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY AVG(ha.attribute_value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many superheroes are taller than 200 cm?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE height_cm > 200

question: Which publisher's superheroes have the highest average Strength?
evidence: Only consider publishers with at least 10 heroes that have a Strength value.
sql: SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY AVG(ha.attribute_value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Name the superheroes that have both Telepathy and Telekinesis.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Telepathy' INTERSECT SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Telekinesis'

question: What is the ratio of good superheroes to bad superheroes?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id

question: How many superheroes have no recorded powers?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power)

question: List the five tallest female superheroes, tallest first.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the most common hair colour among male superheroes?
sql: SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE g.gender = 'Male' AND c.colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many superheroes have a Durability value below 20?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND ha.attribute_value < 20

question: How many superheroes use their full name as their superhero name?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = superhero_name

question: How many more superheroes does Marvel Comics have than DC Comics?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

question: How many power assignments belong to mutant superheroes?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race = 'Mutant'

question: Which gender has the highest average superhero weight?
sql: SELECT g.gender FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE s.weight_kg > 0 GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY AVG(s.weight_kg) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the superheroes heavier than 500 kg together with their publisher.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg > 500

question: Which superheroes have the maximum possible Speed value of 100? Give their superhero names.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100

question: What share of superheroes published by Marvel Comics are good, as a percentage?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

question: How many members wear a Large t-shirt?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE t_shirt_size = 'Large'

question: List the names of the events held in MU 215.
sql: SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE location = 'MU 215'

question: How much money has been spent in total on the Food budget category?
sql: SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

question: How many events were games?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Game'

question: Which member attended the most events? Give the first and last name.
sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much income has the club received from dues in total?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE source = 'Dues'

question: What is the email address of the club president?
sql: SELECT email FROM member WHERE position = 'President'

question: How many members live in Illinois?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE z.state = 'Illinois'

question: Which event had the highest total expense cost?
evidence: total expense cost = SUM(cost) of expenses linked to the event's budgets
sql: SELECT e.event_name FROM expense x JOIN budget b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id ORDER BY SUM(x.cost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average cost of pizza expenses?
sql: SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

question: List the full names of members who paid expenses from an Advertisement budget.
evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM expense x JOIN budget b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN member m ON x.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'

question: Which budget category has the lowest total remaining amount?
sql: SELECT category FROM budget GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(remaining) ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many events took place in 2019?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 4) = '2019'

question: Which major has the most club members?
sql: SELECT mj.major_name FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.major_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the full names of members who have never attended an event.
evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM member WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attendance)

question: What is the total budgeted amount for the October Meeting?
evidence: budgeted amount refers to SUM(amount) of the event's budgets
sql: SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting'

question: How many expenses were made in September 2019?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense WHERE expense_date LIKE '2019-09%'

question: What percentage of events are closed?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM event

question: Who made the single most expensive expense? Give the first and last name.
sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM expense x JOIN member m ON x.link_to_member = m.member_id ORDER BY x.cost DESC LIMIT 1

question: In which city does the club's Vice President live?
evidence: Vice President refers to position = 'Vice President'
sql: SELECT z.city FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

question: How many budgets have been overspent?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget WHERE remaining < 0

question: How many members are there for each t-shirt size?
sql: SELECT t_shirt_size, COUNT(*) FROM member GROUP BY t_shirt_size

question: Which events had a budget for speaker gifts?
evidence: speaker gifts refers to category = 'Speaker Gifts'
sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'

question: How much income did the club receive in October 2019?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE date_received LIKE '2019-10%'

question: Which event had the most attendees?
sql: SELECT e.event_name FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many members attended each event that had at least one attendee?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_event) FROM attendance

question: What are the phone numbers of the members who paid dues in October 2019?
evidence: dues refers to source = 'Dues'; October 2019 refers to date_received LIKE '2019-10%'
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.phone FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE i.source = 'Dues' AND i.date_received LIKE '2019-10%'

question: Which department is Grant Gilmour's major in?
sql: SELECT mj.department FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Grant' AND m.last_name = 'Gilmour'

question: How many open meetings are there?
evidence: open meetings refers to type = 'Meeting' AND status = 'Open'
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting' AND status = 'Open'

question: What is the total cost of expenses paid by members of the College of Humanities and Social Sciences?
sql: SELECT SUM(x.cost) FROM expense x JOIN member m ON x.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE mj.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'

question: How many members live in a state other than the one most members live in?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE z.state <> (SELECT z2.state FROM member m2 JOIN zip_code z2 ON m2.zip = z2.zip_code GROUP BY z2.state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

question: List each budget category with the total amount spent on it, largest first.
sql: SELECT category, SUM(spent) FROM budget GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(spent) DESC

question: Which events in 2020 were elections?
evidence: 2020 refers to SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 4) = '2020'; elections refers to type = 'Election'
sql: SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Election' AND SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 4) = '2020'

question: How many races were held in 2010?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2010

question: Which country has the most circuits?
sql: SELECT country FROM circuits GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is Fernando Alonso's nationality?
sql: SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Fernando' AND surname = 'Alonso'

question: How many drivers were born after 1990?
evidence: born after 1990 refers to STRFTIME('%Y', dob) > '1990'
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', dob) > '1990'

question: At which circuit was the 2015 Monaco Grand Prix held?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year = 2015 AND r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'

question: Which driver has won the most races? Give the forename and surname.
evidence: won refers to position = 1 in results
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.position = 1 GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many races has Lewis Hamilton won?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.position = 1

question: Which constructor scored the most points in the 2012 season?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE r.year = 2012 GROUP BY c.constructorId ORDER BY SUM(cr.points) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who set the fastest lap of the 2009 Australian Grand Prix?
evidence: fastest lap refers to rank = 1 in results
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND res.rank = 1

question: How many pit stops did Sebastian Vettel make in the 2011 Chinese Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitStops p JOIN races r ON p.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2011 AND r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND d.forename = 'Sebastian' AND d.surname = 'Vettel'

question: What was the average pit stop time in milliseconds at the 2012 Malaysian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT AVG(p.milliseconds) FROM pitStops p JOIN races r ON p.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2012 AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

question: List the names of the circuits in Italy.
sql: SELECT name FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Italy'

question: What is Max Verstappen's driver code?
sql: SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Max' AND surname = 'Verstappen'

question: How many races have been held at Silverstone Circuit?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

question: Which driver started from pole position the most times in qualifying?
evidence: pole position refers to qualifying position = 1
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.position = 1 GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many constructors are German?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'German'

question: Apart from finishing, what is the most common race result status?
evidence: Exclude 'Finished' and statuses that start with '+' (lapped cars).
sql: SELECT s.status FROM results r JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId WHERE s.status <> 'Finished' AND s.status NOT LIKE '+%' GROUP BY s.statusId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which season had the most races?
sql: SELECT year FROM races GROUP BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which drivers raced for Ferrari in 2008? Give forename and surname.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE c.name = 'Ferrari' AND r.year = 2008

question: How many points did Michael Schumacher score over his career?
sql: SELECT SUM(r.points) FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'

question: When was the first race held at Monza?
sql: SELECT MIN(r.date) FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.circuitRef = 'monza'

question: How many laps did the winner of the 2014 Italian Grand Prix complete?
sql: SELECT res.laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2014 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND res.position = 1

question: Which circuit lies furthest north?
sql: SELECT name FROM circuits ORDER BY lat DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was Lewis Hamilton's Q1 time at the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT q.q1 FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

question: How many different drivers scored points in the 2016 season?
evidence: scored points refers to points > 0 in results
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2016 AND res.points > 0

question: Who recorded the quickest single lap at the 2010 Bahrain Grand Prix?
evidence: quickest lap refers to MIN(milliseconds) in lapTimes
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM lapTimes l JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2010 AND r.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of race results in 2010 had the status Finished?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN status s ON res.statusId = s.statusId WHERE r.year = 2010

question: What is the nationality of the Red Bull constructor?
sql: SELECT nationality FROM constructors WHERE name = 'Red Bull'

question: How many races in the 2005 season were held in the USA?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year = 2005 AND c.country = 'USA'

question: Who is the youngest driver in the database?
evidence: youngest refers to the latest dob
sql: SELECT forename, surname FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was Jenson Button's championship position after the final race of 2009?
evidence: final race refers to MAX(round) of 2009
sql: SELECT ds.position FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Jenson' AND d.surname = 'Button' AND r.year = 2009 AND r.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2009)

question: What was the average fastest lap speed at the 2010 Monaco Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2010 AND r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'

question: Which drivers have used the permanent number 44?
sql: SELECT forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE number = 44
